errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents the categories “case”, “gender”, “tag”, “number”, and “tense”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly includes "tag" as a category on the x-axis. "tag" is the label for the entire axis, not one of the individual categories shown on it.

errors.text_span: mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ bars reach approximately 11 and 12 units respectively
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the values for the mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ bars in the 'case' category. The chart shows the mBERT-B₂ bar is higher (approx. 12.5) than the XLM-B₂ bar (approx. 11.5), but the description states their values are 11 and 12 respectively, which is the reverse.

errors.text_span: For “gender”, bar heights range from approximately 1 unit for mBERT-R₂ to 4 units for XLM-L₂.
errors.evidence: The description completely misidentifies the models and their values for the 'gender' category. The lowest bar is for XLM-L₂ (approx. 0.5), not mBERT-R₂ (which is approx. 1.8), and the highest is for mBERT-B₂ (approx. 4.2), not XLM-L₂.

errors.text_span: In the “tag” category, the bars are generally shorter, ranging from less than 1 unit to approximately 3 units
errors.evidence: The description invents data for a non-existent x-axis category called "tag". There is no such category in the chart.

errors.text_span: while in “number”, the bars range from approximately 1 to 6 units
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the range for the 'number' category is up to 6 units. The highest bar in this category is clearly below 3 units.

errors.text_span: Lastly, in the “tense” category, the bars range from approximately 1 to 4 units.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the range for the 'tense' category is 1 to 4 units. All bars in this category have values below 1 unit.
